as_told.title: John McCarthy's Stanford AI lab story of the Bureau of Simulation replacing a predictable man

plain: John McCarthy, the computer scientist who ran the artificial intelligence lab at Stanford, used to tell a story in which a man one day gets a letter from the "Bureau of Simulation" that begins "Dear Sir". The computer scientist and UFO researcher Jacques Vallée tells it twice, as a story he heard McCarthy tell around 1968. In his second telling Vallée adds that the story is about replacing a man who has become predictable, the point being that a life easy enough to predict could be run by a simulation.
